intended_object: The fundamental class of the unit circle S¹ ⊆ ℝ², i.e. the class in H₁(S¹; A) of the standard loop t ↦ (cos 2πt, sin 2πt), presented as a morphism A ⟶ H₁(S¹; A) with coefficients in an abelian category with coproducts (from the docstring and module doc).
explanation: The body takes the relative class of the identity 1-simplex of I in H₁(I, ∂I; A) (`cubeRelClass`, whose connecting image is [1] − [0], so the orientation is the standard one). It pushes this class along the standard loop, which is a map of pairs (I, ∂I) → (S¹, {(1,0)}). It then applies the inverse of the quotient isomorphism H₁(S¹) ≅ H₁(S¹, {pt}) (`singularHomologyIsoOfSubsetSingleton` with n = 0, i.e. degree 1). That is exactly the homology class of the standard loop as a 1-cycle, which is the usual fundamental class with the counterclockwise orientation. The object is specific (one particular class of one particular space), so its specificity is not a defect. The coefficients are already more general than abelian groups. I found no comparable definition in Mathlib.
